name: JobSeeeker
description: Scrapes volume -> ingest + silver -> enrich -> gold + cleanup. Started and awaited by the LinkedIn GitHub Actions workflow (databricks/jobs/trigger_job.py --wait) after uploading CSVs; databricks/jobs/publish_to_supabase.py then sends the publish files to Supabase. Needs the unscheduled 'JobSeeker setup' job (01_setup) to have run for the current setup version.

tasks.description: App user data (config/user_data.json from Supabase) -> user tables; Auto Loader: new CSVs -> bronze.jobs_raw; clean, dedupe, MERGE India jobs -> silver.jobs_clean
Pending rows only: language, experience, skills (rules + capped LLM), standard role + category (cached embeddings + LLM tie-break), ops.role_similarity
LinkedIn config exports, MERGE -> gold.jobs, ops.skill_stats, expiry; daily retention, weekly OPTIMIZE/VACUUM; publish files for Supabase (publish/<run_id>/)
